item.title: Farewell to the Ol' Shogun: San Angelo Hibachi and Sushi Spot Closes After 16 Years
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — After more than a decade and a half as a go-to spot for hibachi grills, sushi, and entertaining chef performances, Shogun Steakhouse & Sushi has permanently closed its doors at 4397 Sunset Drive #100. Learn More Here.

item.title: Actress Catherine O’Hara Dies at 71
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Emmy-winning actress Catherine O’Hara has died at the age of 71, according to numerous reports.O’Hara rose to fame with a string of iconic roles, including as Kevin McCallister’s mother in “Home Alone.”She won an Emmy for her role as Moira Rose in the TV series, “Schitt’s Creek.” Learn More Here.

item.title: Angelo State Golf Opens 2026 at the Jack Brown Invitational
item.description: LAREDO, TX — The Angelo State Rambelles opens its 2026 spring season Monday and Tuesday at the Jack Brown Invitational, hosted by Texas A&M International Dustdevils.The 54-hole tournament will be contested Feb. 2–3 at Lakecliff Country Club in Spicewood, Texas, with teams playing 36 holes Monday followed by a final 18-hole round Tuesday. Learn More Here.

item.title: Texas Concrete Supplier Files for Bankruptcy, Cites ICE as Key Factor in Financial Collapse
item.description: MISSION, TX — A major concrete supplier in the Rio Grande Valley has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, with its CEO directly attributing the decision to labor shortages caused by intensified federal immigration enforcement actions.57 Concrete, headquartered in Mission and a primary supplier for residential and commercial construction projects across the region, filed for bankruptcy last month. Learn More Here.

item.title: Here's Why You Don't Take Selfies with Snow Leopards
item.description: KOKTOKAY, CHINA — A female tourist was mauled by a rare snow leopard in northwest China’s Xinjiang region after she left her vehicle and approached the animal to take photographs, authorities said.The attack occurred about 7 p.m. Jan. 23 in Koktokay, a popular ski destination in the Altay prefecture, as the woman was returning to her hotel after a day on the slopes. Learn More Here.

item.title: Road Construction to Restrict Lanes on Edmund Boulevard in San Angelo
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Roadway construction on Edmund Boulevard and West 29th Street will begin Monday and continue through mid-February, the city announced Friday. The work will affect the section between Howard Street and the North Concho River bridge. Two-way traffic will be maintained with one lane open in each direction.
